name: planner
description: Microsoft Planner integration via Microsoft Graph — list plans, buckets, and tasks, read task details and checklists, and create, update, and assign tasks in a Microsoft 365 group's basic plans. Uses app-only (client-credentials) auth with Tasks.Read.All / Tasks.ReadWrite.All application permissions; task updates handle Planner's If-Match ETag concurrency automatically. Works with Microsoft 365 work/school tenants (basic plans only; Planner Premium plans are not available on Graph v1.0).
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Microsoft Planner tasks via Microsoft Graph (app-only)

fields.label: Directory (Tenant) ID
fields.helpText: The Azure AD tenant ID (GUID) of your Microsoft 365 organization.

fields.label: Application (Client) ID
fields.helpText: The Application (client) ID of the app registration.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.helpText: A client secret for the app registration. Requires the Tasks.Read.All (reads) and Tasks.ReadWrite.All (writes) application permissions with admin consent.

fields.label: Default Group ID
fields.helpText: The Microsoft 365 group whose plans to use by default; Graph has no app-only list-all-plans endpoint.

tools.name: planner.list_plans
tools.description: List the Planner plans owned by a Microsoft 365 group (defaults to the connection's default group). Returns id, title, and owner group id per plan (first page of Graph results only).

groupId.description: Microsoft 365 group id whose plans to list (defaults to the connection's defaultGroupId)

tools.name: planner.list_buckets
tools.description: List the buckets (columns) in a Planner plan. Returns id, name, and orderHint per bucket (first page of Graph results only).

planId.description: The Planner plan id to list buckets for

tools.name: planner.list_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks in a Planner plan, or in a single bucket when bucketId is given. Returns id, title, percentComplete, dueDateTime, bucketId, assigned user ids, and priority per task (first page of Graph results only).

planId.description: The Planner plan id to list tasks for (required unless bucketId is given)

bucketId.description: A bucket id to list tasks for instead of the whole plan

tools.name: planner.get_task
tools.description: Get a Planner task including its details: description and checklist items (title/isChecked).

tools.name: planner.create_task
tools.description: Create a new Planner task in a plan, optionally in a specific bucket, with an optional due date and initial assignees.

planId.description: The Planner plan id to create the task in

bucketId.description: Bucket id to place the task in (defaults to the plan's default bucket)

assigneeIds.description: Azure AD user ids to assign the task to

tools.name: planner.update_task
tools.description: Update fields of an existing Planner task (title, percentComplete, dueDateTime, bucketId). Handles the required If-Match ETag and retries once on an edit conflict.

taskId.description: The Planner task id to update

dueDateTime.description: New due date-time (ISO 8601); pass an empty string to clear the due date

bucketId.description: Bucket id to move the task to

tools.name: planner.assign_task
tools.description: Add or remove a user on a Planner task's assignments. Handles the required If-Match ETag and retries once on an edit conflict.

userId.description: Azure AD user id to add or remove

action.description: Whether to add or remove the assignment (default add)
